Quantum 1.43.0 was certified on 2026-11-07. It pins **nucleus v1.34.0**, **quark v1.18.0** and **orbit v1.21.1**, with 28 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.42.0: nucleus goes from v1.33.0 to v1.34.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.17.0 to v1.18.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.20.1 to v1.21.1 (minor). 28 sibling modules change version.
